title: Ue Cracked
features:
🌠 Lucid
A sleek, modern Roblox script built on the Obsidian UI library — clean design, smooth performance, and a full feature set for combat, movement, and visuals.

Version: 1.89
UI: Obsidian + Lucide icons
Platforms: PC & Mobile

⚡ Main (Combat)
Aimbot — with FOV slider, smoothness, lock part, team check, visible-only raycast, and max distance

Triggerbot — customizable delay, works on mobile via VirtualInputManager

FOV Circle — centered on screen, adjustable size, color, fill, and transparency

🧭 Movement
WalkSpeed with multiplier

Sliding Speed with multiplier

Jump Power with multiplier

Noclip

Flight with adjustable speed (WASD-controlled)

Auto Strafe with speed control

Infinite Double Jumps

Long Jump with 3 modes (Under Feet / Behind / Forwards), force, upward velocity, and offset

👁️ Visual
ESP — boxes, names, health bars, distance, gradient health

Skeleton ESP — full R15 bone lines with custom thickness and color

Spoofed Visible / Hidden colors (on-screen vs off-screen)

Custom colors for: visible, hidden, teammate, outline, name, distance, health BG, health fill, skeleton

Team Check and Use Teammate Color options

Range slider (10–1000 studs)

RTX Toggle — one-click enhanced lighting with reflections and bloom

🎭 Spoof
Coming soon — reserved for future identity-disguise features

⚙️ Settings
Built-in Theme Manager (light/dark/custom)

SaveManager — save, load, and autoload your config

One-click Unload button

✨ Why Lucid?
Smooth aimbot — no screen shake, no jitter, frame-rate independent

Mobile-first aim — hold screen to aim, no extra toggles

Self-healing ESP — never breaks on respawn or player join

Fully customizable — every color, slider, and toggle is yours to tune

Clean UI — no clutter, no emoji spam, no bloat
